title: Create a useDebounce Composable
description: Build a composable that debounces a value and use it to delay search input.
problemStatement:
## Problem Statement

Create a composable called `useDebounce` that takes a `ref` and a delay (ms) and returns a new ref that updates only after the source has stopped changing for the specified delay.

- The debounced ref should initially have the same value as the source.
- When the source changes, the debounced value should update only after `delay` milliseconds of no further changes.

Use this composable in a search component:
- An input bound to a `search` ref.
- A debounced search term `debouncedSearch` created with `useDebounce(search, 500)`.
- Display both the immediate search value and the debounced value.
- Simulate an API call when the debounced value changes (e.g., console log or update a message).

**Bonus**: Add an abort controller to cancel pending requests on new debounce.
hints:
Inside `useDebounce`, create a new ref `debouncedValue`.
    Use `watch` on the source to set a timeout and update the debounced value after the delay.
Clear the timeout if the source changes again within the delay.
expectedOutput: A search input showing live and debounced values, with simulated search when debounced changes.
